newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Agroprombank to become investment company.
newsitem.headline: Russian Agroprombank to become investment company.

text.p: Agroprombank, part of Russia's Stolichny Bank Sberezheny-Agro group, will become an investment company for agricultural companies, Stolichny said on Monday.
In a separate move aimed at continuing capital restucturing, Agroprombank's board decided to make a new 500 billion rouble share issue, Stolichny's spokesman told Reuters.

In November Stolichny Bank Sberezheny won a tender for 50 percent plus one share in troubled Agroprombank -- a bank dedicated to servicing Russia's agricultural sector -- by taking up a 130 billion rouble share issue.
The issue increased Agroprombank's authorised capital to 260 billion roubles.
Under the terms of the tender Stolichny had to preserve Agrprombank's specialisation as a bank for the agricultural sector.
The latest move makes Agroprombank Stolichny's investment arm and adviser in its credits to agriculture.
In January Agroprombank's board decided to increase the bank's authorised capital to 520 billion roubles from 260 billion roubles, but the issue is not yet registered at the Central Bank.
The board also decided to pay the bank's 400 billion rouble debt to municipalities and depositors, the spokesman said.
